entry: resting limit at box midpoint; buy rounds down and sell rounds up to 0.25-point NQ tick
orderPriority: nearest fresh correct-side visible zone from prior close, ties yellow then older formation/key; selected before seeing candle high/low
breakEvenStop: modeled fill price; gross break-even before unspecified costs
firstTouchPolicy: first-band-contact attempt only; unfilled midpoint consumes attempt; prior hidden contacts excluded using touchedAt
sessionExit: flatten at NY session close; positive partial exits listed separately from 130-point TP wins
ambiguousOhlcPolicy: do not invent intrabar order; ambiguous trade blocks further entries for that NY session
gapPolicy: observed opening-price improvement for entry; active stop gap fills at open and risk violation is reported, never capped fictitiously
reactionStudy: separate 5/15/30-minute post-contact-close +/-15 benchmark; not trade win rate
pilotReplay: continuous prefix from archive first candle through 2026-01-23 UTC; no daily cold restarts
holdoutPolicy: no replay/scoring of reserved 2026-03-18 to 2026-04-15 validation period in this pilot
